answers.core: It seems natural that Godot should support multichannel audio sources beyond stereo, as well as surround panning, when Godot already partially supports surround sound through AudioStreamPlayer3D.
answers.workaround: I don't believe so, in my concrete case I was forced to implement the audio for my project using a C# audio library, completely bypassing godots audio system.

title: Add support for import and playback of audio files with more than two channels
